objective: Implement the C3 done-notification dispatch in mark_done: after a successful transition, send exactly one webhook via the existing WebhookDispatcher with the C3 payload ({event:'todo.done', todo_id, title, at}); zero dispatches when webhook_url is absent; a no-escape exception boundary (DA-2) enforces that a raising dispatcher never breaks the done transition (200 + done state intact)

concepts: fire-and-forget dispatch: WebhookDispatcher.send records/returns a status and never raises by design (A-2)
DA-2 boundary: dispatch strictly after the store mutation, exception caught+logged, never propagated
idempotent done transition: repeated done still returns 200
frozen done-transition HTTP behavior (200 {id, done:true}, 404 unknown id) — unchanged

inputs: inlined frozen contracts C2/C3 (below) — do not read stage-contract.json
T01 checkpoint: webhook_url present on records; store behavior verified

frozen_contracts.spec: todo record shape in store: {id: 't<n>', title: string, done: boolean, tag?: string, webhook_url?: string}; creation order preserved. Stage-2 additive: webhook_url (optional string) added per C2's unfreeze rule (additive-only; stage 2 proposes it in writing in this contract). last_notified_at is intentionally NOT added — it ships only if/when C1 is revised (see Q1).

done-notification contract: on a successful mark_done (todo exists, transition applied), exactly one webhook is dispatched to the todo's webhook_url with payload {event: 'todo.done', todo_id: string, title: string, at: ISO-8601 timestamp}; if webhook_url is absent, exactly zero dispatches. Dispatch never affects the HTTP result: POST /todos/{id}/done returns 200 {id, done: true} (404 for unknown id) regardless of dispatch outcome, and a dispatch exception is caught+logged, never raised

allowed_dependencies.what: the webhook_url field on the todo record (C2 additive) that the dispatch reads

non_goals: app/webhooks.py — reuse only, never modify (frozen infra)
the GET /todos response shape (C1 frozen; last_notified_at is Q1, deferred)
webhook retry, delivery history, or management endpoints
implementation_constraints: reuse the existing WebhookDispatcher as the only dispatch seam — no new HTTP client, worker, or queue
stdlib only; no new third-party imports
dispatch strictly after the store mutation, inside a try/except that logs and swallows (DA-2)
done-transition HTTP behavior unchanged: 200 {id, done:true}, 404 unknown id
frozen stage-1 suite tests/test_api.py stays green

deliverables.what: mark_done dispatches per C3 (exactly one / exactly zero) with the no-escape boundary
unit tests: one-dispatch, no-URL zero-dispatch, raising-dispatcher tolerance, C1 key-set unchanged

acceptance_tests.description: todo with webhook_url marked done: WebhookLog.sent has exactly 1 entry with the C3 payload {event:'todo.done', todo_id, title, at} and the response status is 200
acceptance_tests.evidence: test tests/test_notifications.py::test_done_dispatches_one_webhook asserts exactly 1 entry in WebhookLog.sent

acceptance_tests.description: todo without webhook_url marked done: WebhookLog.sent stays empty, response status 200, no default URL invented
acceptance_tests.evidence: test tests/test_notifications.py::test_done_without_url_dispatches_nothing asserts an empty dispatch log

acceptance_tests.description: dispatcher whose send() raises RuntimeError: mark done still returns status 200, the store record is done=true, no exception reaches the caller
after the dispatch work, GET /todos per-todo keys are exactly {id, title, done}(+tag) and no last_notified_at key appears — the test asserts the exact key set
acceptance_tests.evidence: test tests/test_notifications.py::test_get_todos_key_set_unchanged asserts the exact per-todo key set

failure_cases.expected_behavior: the exception is caught at the DA-2 boundary, a log entry is written, and it is swallowed: response status 200, todo done, no half-state
zero dispatches; the transition proceeds normally with status 200

failure_cases.scenario: mark_done called with an unknown todo id
failure_cases.expected_behavior: returns 404 {error} status before any dispatch — the test asserts zero dispatches for a failed transition

upstream_outputs: T01: webhook_url field on the todo record

handoff.notes: checkpoint must record: dispatch count assertions passed (one/zero), raising-dispatcher tolerance asserted by test, C1 key set verified unchanged, webhooks.py untouched
